savollar.q: Choose the correct option: She ___ to work by bus every day.
savollar.e: Present Simple — odatiy harakat (every day), 3-shaxs birlikda -s/-es.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
savollar.e: "Look!" — hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakat: Present Continuous.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: I ___ this film three times already.
savollar.e: "already" va natija hozirga bog'liq — Present Perfect.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: We ___ in London since 2015.
savollar.e: "since" + hozirgacha davom etgan holat — Present Perfect.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: He ___ his keys yesterday.
Choose the correct option: When I arrived, they ___ dinner.
savollar.e: O'tgan zamondagi davomli harakat boshqa harakat bilan kesishgan — Past Continuous.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: By the time we got to the station, the train ___.
savollar.e: O'tgan voqeadan oldin tugagan harakat — Past Perfect.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: I ___ for two hours when she finally called.
savollar.e: O'tgan nuqtagacha davom etgan harakat — Past Perfect Continuous.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: She ___ English for five years and still enjoys it.
savollar.e: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon — Present Perfect Continuous.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: This time tomorrow I ___ on the beach.
savollar.e: Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etadigan harakat — Future Continuous.

savollar.q: Choose the correct option: By next June, we ___ the project.
Choose the correct option: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
savollar.e: Hozirgi belgiga asoslangan bashorat — be going to.

savollar.q: Report: She said, "I am tired."
